column2: Assembly mat ~600 x 400 with all 8 items laid out and numbered (screwdriver, wrist strap, thermal paste, screw kit tray, cable ties, power cord coiled, wifi antennas, flush cutter)
Precision-to-medium Phillips screwdriver ~200 long, magnetic hex bit holder, two reversible bits PH2 (main) and PH1 (M.2 screw), rubber two-tone handle
Anti-static wrist strap: adjustable elastic band with metal plate, coiled lead ~1.8 m with 1 MOhm resistor, alligator clip that clips onto bare metal of the case frame
Thermal paste syringe ~2 g (about 70 long), cap, plunger, plus a small plastic spreader card; show the pea-size dot on a CPU lid

Clear compartment tray (screw organizer ~150 x 100 x 20, lid) holding: 9 brass M3 standoffs h6.5, M3x5 board screws, #6-32x6 PSU/PCIe screws, fan self-tapping 5x10, M3x6 and M3x30 radiator screws, M2x2.5 M.2 screw + M.2 standoff, thumbscrews #6-32, hex 5 mm standoff socket; label each compartment by number
Cable management: bundle of nylon zip ties 100 x 2.5 (show head ratchet), and 3 reusable hook-and-loop straps 150 x 12; show one tie closed around a cable bundle
Mains power cord 1.5 m: IEC C13 female plug (3 holes, keyed shape) to wall plug with 2 round pins 4.8 mm (Vietnam/EU type), black, coiled; show C13 mating the PSU C14 inlet
Pair of screw-on dipole Wi-Fi antennas ~110 long with swivel joint and RP-SMA nut, matching the 2 antenna ports on the Gaming motherboard rear I/O
Small flush side cutter ~125 long with spring and rubber grips, used to trim zip tie tails flush
